text: The International Preparatory Program is a non-academic pre-school preparatory education program for international students set up by the College of Lifelong Education of Shanghai Jiao Tong University. The Foundation program is tailored to the characteristics of international students. International students can improve their language, professional and cross-cultural communication skills according to their needs, and lay a solid foundation for future university studies. International preparatory students who pass the official assessment can be prefered to study at Shanghai Jiao Tong University. International Preparatory Students Program includes: Project A enrollment target is international students who have a good Chinese language foundation (HSK 4≧180 or equivalent Chinese language level) and need to further improve their Chinese, English, mathematics and other subjects. Project B provides Chinese language training for international students with no or weak Chinese language foundation but good performance in other subjects, and also helps students improve their academic ability in mathematics, English and other aspects. For international students who have a certain English foundation and need to further improve their English, mathematics and other subjects, this program is taught in English. The above three types of projects are set up according to the needs of science, agriculture, medicine and humanities and social sciences two major directions. The department of Science, Agriculture and Medicine corresponds to the majors of shipbuilding and ocean engineering, mechanical engineering, computer science and technology, software engineering, materials science and Engineering, aerospace engineering, environmental science and engineering, Chemical Engineering and technology, statistics, biotechnology, biomedical engineering, pharmacy, Clinical medicine, Stomatology, etc. Humanities and Social Sciences correspond to finance, economics, business administration, accounting, communication, radio and television production, visual communication design, language and other majors.
